whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Khanak The Soul,

I noticed your boutique has an exceptional 4.8★ rating with strong reviews in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new customer inquiries.

Maine aapke boutique ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp collection inquiry, product catalog, aur studio timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/khanak

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Khanak The Soul) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp inquiry and a showcase of your boutique collection right in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact collections aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
